add.title: Remove ask_mastermind: the tool, its voice-<id> spawn, the reply-file/ticket protocol, voice_hear, and their tests
add.why: The owner (2026-11-06) wants voice to use spawn_agent + send_to_agent + updates. Since that date the instructions call ask_mastermind deprecated (RemoteMCP.INSTRUCTIONS, cloud-voice-agent.md). The code that remains: RemoteMCP.js TOOL/HEAR/ask()/spawn()/tickets (about 250 lines), RemoteMCP.test.mjs (5 ask cases), and Sessions.js HANDOFF_TOOL. Remove it once a voice call has gone a day without calling it (see remote_mcp lines in ai/log.jsonl).
